snippet.title: Graveyard Keeper 2 - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Graveyard Keeper 2: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358690 

Graveyard Keeper 2 is a narrative-driven crafting RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. This sequel builds on the cult-favorite formula, expanding it into a zombie-infested Town. Craft, trade, optimize supply chains, manage your graveyard, and send undead expeditions to reclaim and revive the city. More graves, a bigger Town, and even more questionable morals. Graveyard Keeper 2 will be available on PC, Xbox Series, PS5, Switch 1 and Switch 2. To celebrate the announcement at the Triple-i Initiative, Graveyard Keeper 1 will be available for free on Steam, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S but only for a limited time.

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
